whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Grind House,

I noticed your cafe has incredible 4.3★ reviews with over 1,600 happy customers in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and table reservation page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu items, aur ambience showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://thegrindhouse-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Grind House, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu showcase, and your Kankarbagh location highlight. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
